name: issue-216-toolbar-hidden
description: docs/specs/toolbar-toggle.md: Firefox's toolbar is hidden by default (decision 3, since 19 Nov 2026); the page starts under the tab line, which two tabs draw by default (docs/specs/tab-line.md decision 3, since 20 Nov 2026), at the window's height less the line and the status bar (its title, edge 759), ctrl+b u shows the toolbar and ctrl+b u again hides it, and the page (fixture edge.html, its blue band at its top edge; the shot waits out the notice) reaches the tab line with the status bar below (toolbar-hidden.png); I shows the minimal bar over the page, only the URL field with the typed address, the page not resized (its title, edge <innerHeight>, unchanged) (toolbar-minimal.png); Enter loads the address and the bar hides again. Firefox's suggestions are off, so the minimal-bar shot holds only the field and its one heuristic row.

steps.keys: a b o u t : b l a n k
